name: Messaging, hourly
description: Every hour: mirrors this app into the messaging service (members, kinds of message, audiences; the platform's own messages made once) and feeds the digest and the app's own nudges with what they say. One http step to this app's own /msghook/hourly, signed as the app by the runtime (no secret in this file); the answer lists what was done. The service keeps the ledger and sends; a run that is repeated or interrupted never sends twice.
